policy: Push to the experiment branch triggers no workflow; the draft PR (kemiller2002/Indy-init#140) triggers 'Preflight tooling' (cancel-in-progress per PR) and 'Indy Init offline factory rehearsal'. Required CI = both, on the final candidate head.

runs.head: 2f7ebf7
runs.note: superseded by my push of c7e97c4 (cancel-in-progress); its r10-adversarial aggregator reported the cancelled shards as a failure

findings: CI-F3: at 21:47Z the stop hook forced a push of the docs-only commit, cancelling Preflight on 76d88cd mid-run (offline-factory, offline-contract-tests and frozen-v4 had already passed there). The docs-only head (identical application code) became the final candidate.

CI-F2: the session stop hook requires every commit to be pushed before the coordinator waits, so batching pushes is not possible while waiting on agents; each push re-triggers both PR workflows and cancels Preflight on the superseded head.

CI-F1 (agent coordination / CI waste): four pushes within 4 minutes while the PR was open cancelled three Preflight runs before they finished. From 21:41Z the coordinator commits locally and pushes only the final candidate.
